notes.title: Idol Hands Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Thanks to amazing feedback from the Idol Hands community, we are pleased to announce there will be an update coming to the game on 5TH MARCH 2015.
 
This will include:
-        The ability to press any key to skip through the logos video section of the game.

-        The ability to press any key to skip through the four tutorials.

-        The implementation of WASD keys for moving forward, backwards and strafing left/right. You will still be able to use LMB to drag the landscape if you desire.

-        A change to the mapping of hot keys to match WASD layout; T for totem, YUIOP for godly powers and ZXC for terraforming. +/- for zoom (with localised WASD hot key updates coming in the future).

-        The ability to use the Right Mouse Button + left/right movement to rotate camera. 

-        The ability to zoom the camera in/out using the mouse wheel or (+/- hot keys). 

We really value everyone’s feedback so please continue to let us know how we can improve the game! We will have more updates and Idol Hands DLC news coming very soon!
